ddl: CREATE INDEX ix_v2_art_reference_decisions_project_subject ON v2_art_reference_decisions (project_id, subject_type, subject_id, reference_revision)
CREATE INDEX ix_v2_character_imported_appearances_project_character ON v2_character_imported_appearances (project_id, character_id, created_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_v2_character_reference_decisions_project_character ON v2_character_reference_decisions (project_id, character_id, reference_revision)
CREATE INDEX ix_v2_same_person_reviews_project_binding_revision ON v2_same_person_reviews (project_id, binding_id, review_revision)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_v2_art_proposal_final_delivery ON v2_art_reference_proposal_deliveries (proposal_id) WHERE delivery_id IS NOT NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_v2_character_proposal_final_delivery ON v2_character_reference_proposal_deliveries (proposal_id) WHERE delivery_id IS NOT NULL

CREATE TABLE v2_art_reference_decision_states (
	project_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	subject_type VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	subject_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	active_decision_id VARCHAR(36), 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (project_id, subject_type, subject_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES v2_projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(active_decision_id) REFERENCES v2_art_reference_decisions (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

CREATE TABLE v2_art_reference_decisions (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	project_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	subject_type VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	subject_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	reference_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	accepted_art_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	accepted_art_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	subject JSON NOT NULL, 
	subject_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	asset_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	asset_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	proposal_id VARCHAR(67) NOT NULL, 
	candidate_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES v2_projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(asset_id) REFERENCES v2_managed_assets (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(proposal_id) REFERENCES v2_art_reference_proposals (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(candidate_id) REFERENCES v2_art_reference_proposal_candidates (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

CREATE TABLE v2_art_reference_proposal_candidates (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	proposal_id VARCHAR(67) NOT NULL, 
	delivery_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	asset_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	output_filename VARCHAR(180) NOT NULL, 
	output_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_v2_art_proposal_candidate_asset UNIQUE (delivery_id, asset_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(proposal_id) REFERENCES v2_art_reference_proposals (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(delivery_id) REFERENCES v2_art_reference_proposal_deliveries (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(asset_id) REFERENCES v2_managed_assets (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

CREATE TABLE v2_art_reference_proposal_deliveries (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	proposal_id VARCHAR(67) NOT NULL, 
	delivery_id VARCHAR(128), 
	manifest JSON, 
	manifest_hash VARCHAR(64), 
	state VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	diagnostic_code VARCHAR(80), 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_v2_art_proposal_delivery_identity UNIQUE (proposal_id, delivery_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(proposal_id) REFERENCES v2_art_reference_proposals (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

CREATE TABLE v2_art_reference_proposals (
	id VARCHAR(67) NOT NULL, 
	project_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	subject_type VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	subject_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	request JSON NOT NULL, 
	request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	exported_at DATETIME, 
	cancelled_at DATETIME, 
	cancellation_reason TEXT, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES v2_projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	UNIQUE (request_hash)
)

CREATE TABLE v2_character_imported_appearances (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	project_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	character_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	asset_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	character_context JSON NOT NULL, 
	character_context_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	label VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_v2_character_imported_appearance UNIQUE (project_id, character_id, asset_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES v2_projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(asset_id) REFERENCES v2_managed_assets (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

CREATE TABLE v2_character_reference_decisions (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	project_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	character_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	reference_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	character_context JSON NOT NULL, 
	character_context_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	primary_asset_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	complementary_asset_ids JSON NOT NULL, 
	asset_hashes JSON NOT NULL, 
	reviewer VARCHAR(160), 
	notes TEXT, 
	revoked_at DATETIME, 
	revoked_by VARCHAR(160), 
	revocation_reason TEXT, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_v2_character_reference_revision UNIQUE (project_id, character_id, reference_revision), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES v2_projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(primary_asset_id) REFERENCES v2_managed_assets (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

CREATE TABLE v2_character_reference_proposal_candidates (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	proposal_id VARCHAR(67) NOT NULL, 
	delivery_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	asset_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	output_filename VARCHAR(180) NOT NULL, 
	output_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_v2_character_proposal_candidate_asset UNIQUE (delivery_id, asset_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(proposal_id) REFERENCES v2_character_reference_proposals (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(delivery_id) REFERENCES v2_character_reference_proposal_deliveries (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(asset_id) REFERENCES v2_managed_assets (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

CREATE TABLE v2_character_reference_proposal_deliveries (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	proposal_id VARCHAR(67) NOT NULL, 
	delivery_id VARCHAR(128), 
	manifest JSON, 
	manifest_hash VARCHAR(64), 
	state VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	diagnostic_code VARCHAR(80), 
	publication_phase VARCHAR(24), 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_v2_character_proposal_delivery_identity UNIQUE (proposal_id, delivery_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(proposal_id) REFERENCES v2_character_reference_proposals (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

CREATE TABLE v2_character_reference_proposals (
	id VARCHAR(67) NOT NULL, 
	project_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	character_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	parent_candidate_asset_id VARCHAR(36), 
	request JSON NOT NULL, 
	request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	exported_at DATETIME, 
	cancelled_at DATETIME, 
	cancellation_reason TEXT, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES v2_projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(parent_candidate_asset_id) REFERENCES v2_managed_assets (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	UNIQUE (request_hash)
)

CREATE TABLE v2_character_reference_states (
	project_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	character_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	active_decision_id VARCHAR(36), 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (project_id, character_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES v2_projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE v2_same_person_review_states (
	project_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (project_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES v2_projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE v2_same_person_reviews (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	project_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	binding_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	review_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	reference_bindings JSON NOT NULL, 
	comparisons JSON NOT NULL, 
	reviewer VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	notes TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES v2_projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(binding_id) REFERENCES v2_reviewed_shot_bindings (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)
